name: Luồng 5 - Human-in-the-Loop Web Approval & Outbound Dispatch (12 Nodes)

parameters.query: SELECT d.*, t.id AS t_id, t.ticket_code AS t_code, t.created_at AS ticket_created_at, t.sla_due_at, t.first_response_sla FROM email_drafts d LEFT JOIN tickets t ON (d.ticket_id = t.id OR d.ticket_code = t.ticket_code) WHERE d.id = $1 LIMIT 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [Number($('1. Human Action Webhook Trigger').first().json.body?.draft_id || $('1. Human Action Webhook Trigger').first().json.draft_id || 1)] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO ticket_comments (ticket_id, author_type, content) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM tickets WHERE ticket_code = $1 LIMIT 1), 'HUMAN_AGENT', $2) RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('4. Email Address Validation Code').first().json.ticket_code, $('4. Email Address Validation Code').first().json.final_subject + ' | Đã gửi phản hồi thành công qua SMTP'] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO system_audit_logs (event_type, workflow_id, description, payload_snapshot) VALUES ($1, 'flow05_hitl_approval_send', $2, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO system_audit_logs (event_type, workflow_id, description, payload_snapshot) VALUES ('OUTBOUND_EMAIL_SUCCESSFULLY_SENT', 'flow05_hitl_approval_send', 'Email phản hồi khách hàng đã được gửi thành công sau khi phê duyệt HITL', $1::jsonb) RETURNING id;
